description: Change an organization member's role. Returns a preview; re-call with the confirm_token and an idempotency_key to commit. Cannot assign the Owner role. Cannot escalate beyond your own role.

confirm_token.description: Token returned by the preview (call this tool once with no token to get it). Required to commit; expires in ~10 minutes.

idempotency_key.description: Required when committing (confirm_token present): retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

new_role.description: New role to assign: Admin, Finance, Manager, Member, or Viewer.

org_user_id.description: Id of the OrganizationUser record to update (not the Firebase userId).

name: change_user_role
